From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sat, 12 May 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice slate alignment and PO timing — Orchid Systems

Team —

Quick heads-up on Orchid (RWINF-2028-ORC-42): procurement has told us they want a single invoice for the first 12 months tied to a PO that lands before the end of May. That creates a hard cutoff for recognition this quarter. Can we do a rapid sweep on the deal so finance can lock the booking if the PO arrives?

Asks: 
- Sales: confirm that Stage is "Commit" in HubSpot (not just Contract Sent) by EOD Monday.
- Legal/Contracts (Marissa): flag any term items that would prevent the PO being accepted as-is.
- Ops (Jonas): confirm whether we can route an invoice to their AP team once the PO is in — any billing account mapping gaps?

I attached a short checklist and the PO template they prefer. If the PO slips past 5/31 we risk pushing recognition to the next fiscal period. Short replies ok.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Hannah — noted. I spoke to the AE (notes in HubSpot) and the customer explicitly asked that billing be consolidated into a single upfront invoice. I've updated the deal stage to "Commit" and added the expected PO arrival date: 2028-05-25.

Immediate blockers I see: 
- Contract still contains one redline on data residency (legal is reviewing) — Marissa, any ETA?
- Customer asked for 45-day payment terms on the invoice; that's longer than standard but they are asking for it up front.

If Marissa can sign off on the current draft by Monday we should be able to accept PO and invoice the full term once PO is received. I can follow up with Sarah at Orchid to confirm payment terms are acceptable to AP.
